summary.text: Dave Armstrong is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 67 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Indiana Thompson.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as executive director.

paragraphs.text: David Armstrong's career experience includes working as executive director of the Barron County Economic Development Corporation, starting two companies in the medical field, and serving as vice president of substance abuse services for Healthcomp Evaluation Services Corporation.
He served two terms on the Rice Lake City Council and has served on the Rice Lake Cable Commission, Utility Commission, Tourism Commission and Chamber of Commerce board.
He also served as president of the Law Enforcement Foundation of Barron County and as a volunteer mentor at Rice Lake High School.
Armstrong's Ballotpedia profile gives his Assembly tenure as beginning in 2021.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Housing and Real Estate, Jobs and the Economy, Rural Development (vice-chair), Small Business Development (chair), Workforce Development, and Ways and Means.
